requirements.title: Dummy procedures and dummy procedure pointers are dummy arguments used as procedures
requirements.definition: A dummy argument specified as a procedure or used as the procedure designator in a procedure reference is a dummy procedure; a dummy procedure with POINTER is a dummy procedure pointer.

pending.dummy-procedure-specified-as-procedure: Define subroutine apply(proc, x) with an explicit dummy procedure proc and integer x initialized to 41; call proc to add one and expect x == 42.
pending.dummy-procedure-as-procedure-designator: Inside apply(proc), execute y = proc(41) with y initialized to -777 and proc supplied as plus_one returning 42. Wrong-resolution sentinel companion also provides host function plus_one returning -999; passing that procedure instead changes y to -999, proving the dummy designator path is load-bearing.
pending.dummy-procedure-pointer-has-pointer-attr: Define subroutine call_pointer(proc) with PROCEDURE(integer_fun), POINTER dummy proc associated with target answer; result variable starts at -3 and call expects 42.

requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: clauses 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, and 13 for source form, declarations, expressions, execution constructs, data transfer, and formatting foundations already present in this suite. Unregistered dependencies retained for future fixtures: later clause 15 procedure reference, argument association, interface block, generic resolution, pure/simple/elemental, procedure pointer, and finalization rules; clauses 16, 17, and 18 for intrinsic and intrinsic-module procedures; clause 14 for modules and submodules; clause 3 terminology and clause 19 scoping/lifetime details.
